purpose: Teach: 血糖/プラズマ/精子/形容詞/同胞/軍国/乳幼児/生誕

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、糖尿病患者の血糖値を医療チームで日々管理します
lines.en: Ren, we manage blood sugar levels for our diabetic patients as a team every single day.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Professional but not distant. Slight pause after his name to ensure he's tracking. Steady eye contact level throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: プラズマ滅菌装置を、貴院、導入されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital uses plasma sterilization equipment, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Tentative but genuine curiosity. Gentle lean forward. Careful articulation—he's working through medical vocabulary. Respectful lift at the end, genuinely asking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、不妊治療での精子検査を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes, we conduct sperm analysis for fertility treatments as part of our comprehensive team approach.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. No condescension despite the sensitive subject matter. Direct but not clinical. Brief, confident.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療現場での形容詞使いを、貴院、丁寧にされてますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital takes care with medical terminology in patient communication, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, not a question disguised as one. Slight uncertainty in the middle—he's noticing something but isn't entirely sure if it's intentional. Respectful close.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、在外同胞向け医療相談を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes, we provide medical consultation and support for overseas compatriots through our coordinated team.
lines.style: Clear affirmation. Warm acknowledgment of the question. Practiced delivery—this is something the hospital takes pride in. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 軍国主義時代の医療史を、貴院、教育に活かされてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital incorporates medical history—even from difficult periods—into your education, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, almost hesitant phrasing. He's asking something deeper than the surface words. Respectful but genuinely interested in how she answers. Slight vulnerability underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、乳幼児の健診を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team handles infant health screenings with care and thoroughness.
lines.style: Calm, assured. A gentle note of dedication when she says 'care.' Not rushed. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、生誕直後の新生児ケアを医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Yes, we give careful, attentive newborn care right from birth as a unified team.
lines.style: Tender precision. Slower, more deliberate than previous lines. Slight softness on 'careful' and 'attentive.' Pride in the specificity of what they do. Trailing thought—like there's more care in that moment than words alone convey.
